content_fields.title: Test environmental vulnerabilities (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Resolve the script and its dependencies from absolute paths so the caller's environment cannot redirect them.
content_fields.finding: The script invokes a sibling script by relative path, resolving it from the caller's working directory and environment.
content_fields.required_fix:
#!/bin/bash
# start_game.sh
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"

"$SCRIPT_DIR/start_app.sh" -d
docker compose exec -T web python3 /app/game.py
criteria: Sibling scripts are invoked through an absolute, resolved path.
PATH is set before any external command runs.
The script does not depend on the caller's working directory.
